title: A precise descriptive title
claim: State the exact mathematical proposition, including quantifiers and assumptions.
novelty: Explain what this adds relative to the repository. Identify established results honestly.

prior_art.reference: Source title and URL, or none identified
prior_art.relationship: Explain what is reused and what differs.

evidence.reproduce: The trusted verifier compiles the expression against the pinned definition using Lean 4.19.0.

attribution.contributions: Describe this contributor's work and any assistance.

limitations: State unproved claims, scope restrictions and known weaknesses. This does not resolve P vs NP.
